title: Osteoporosis: Can It Happen to You ?
abstract:
Though small bones and a thin frame increase your risk, those who have a larger frame can still get osteoporosis.
With osteoporosis, even a simple activity such as · picking up a grocery bag can cause a fracture. If you’ve had one fracture, you may be at higher risk for another
The self-assessment below helps you determine your risk for developing osteoporosis.
Though family history increases your risk, people with no family history may develop osteoporosis.
